This is an entirely invented bedtime story. A tiny caterpillar called  lives inside a paper lantern in the imaginary village of Pofflemere. Nera Pindle brings it a blue leaf each evening. Tonight the caterpillar borrowed a fish puppet, crossed the little bridge and fell asleep beside a basket. The story ended when Nera carried the basket home. I drew the lantern in my diary afterwards.
